summary: Completed testing of DAP visibility feature for all roles. Backend tests: 15 passed, 1 skipped. Frontend tests confirmed DAP Status card is visible to Buyer, User, and Department Head roles. Process Engineer has department-based restrictions on request list but can access DAP via API.
seed_data_creation: Created test capex request and DAP during backend testing (cleaned up after tests)
context_for_next_testing_agent: DAP visibility feature is working correctly. The standalone DAP Status card (data-testid='dap-documents-card') is rendered outside the buyer_module wrapper in RequestDetail.jsx, making it visible to all roles when a DAP exists. Backend API tests confirm all 4 roles (buyer, user, department_head, process_engineering) can access DAP details via GET /api/dap/{dap_id}. Frontend tests confirm the DAP card shows: status badge, approval progress (PE/DH/User), documents with download links, and role-specific approval buttons.
